items: Changing rung 01 (`EncVigilantOfStendarr01MeleeTemplate` 10C44C) also needs `ccMTYSSE002_Azir` 00095C:ccmtysse002-ve.esl (Azarain, level 19): it uses the rung-01 leaf `EncVigilantOfStendarr01DarkElfF` 10C44E as its template but not for `Stats` (on *Named Vigilants*). The race records of rungs 02–05 also use the rung-01 leaves without `Stats`, so changing rung 01 does not move them.

Changing `EncVigilantOfStendarr05NordM04` 10C488 also needs `ccMTYSSE002_Fenrik` 00095F:ccmtysse002-ve.esl (PC × 1, min 10, max 30): same pattern (on Vampires → *Common Vampires*). The SilverHand Vigilant 000965, a row, keeps its own 19 the same way.
The other rows: no other record keeps its own level.

Every other Vigilant record (the rung-01 race leaves, the intro pair, the corpses, every `LvlVigilantOfStendarr…` wrapper, the Charmed Vigilants, The Cause's wrappers and prisoners, `DLC1VigilantAdalvald`, `DLC1DunRuunvaldVolk`) carries `Stats` and follows its template or list.
